mapper.select: select * from fund_allocation_record where record_id=#{recordId} and del_flag='0'
select * from fund_allocation_record where plan_id=#{planId} and del_flag='0' order by allocation_time desc,record_id desc
select coalesce(sum(amount),0) from fund_allocation_record where plan_id=#{planId} and del_flag='0'
select coalesce(sum(r.amount),0) from fund_allocation_record r join fund_allocation_plan p on p.plan_id=r.plan_id and p.del_flag='0' where p.topic_id=#{topicId} and r.del_flag='0'
select count(1) from fund_allocation_record where plan_id=#{planId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.update: update fund_allocation_record set allocation_name=#{allocationName},amount=#{amount},allocation_time=#{allocationTime},fund_desc=#{fundDesc},voucher_urls=#{voucherUrls},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where record_id=#{recordId} and del_flag='0'
update fund_allocation_record set del_flag='2',update_time=sysdate() where record_id=#{recordId}
